children: SURPRISE, Ariz., Sept. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SenesTech, Inc. (NASDAQ: SNES), the leader in rodent birth control and sustainable rodent population management, today announced that its Evolve® family of rodent birth control products will soon be available through Grove Collaborative's online marketplace. The launch will expand consumer access to an innovative rodent control solution for environmentally conscious households.

Grove Collaborative is a leading sustainable consumer products marketplace offering products that meet rigorous standards for sustainability, ingredient transparency and performance. Its customers are highly engaged in finding effective and responsible solutions for their homes, making Evolve a strong addition to the Grove platform.

"Grove has built a loyal customer base by carefully selecting products that deliver strong performance while supporting more sustainable choices," said Michael Edell, President and Chief Executive Officer of SenesTech. "Evolve gives these consumers an effective rodent birth control solution that targets reproduction without relying solely on traditional rodenticides."

Evolve® products incorporate naturally derived ingredients that meet the EPA's minimum risk criteria. The products are designed to help reduce rodent populations and can be used independently or as part of an integrated pest management program.

"Grove represents more than simply another online sales channel for us," continued Edell. "It gives us the opportunity to introduce Evolve to consumers whose purchasing priorities closely match the product's combination of performance, innovation and sustainability."

The launch represents another step in SenesTech's strategy to expand the availability of its consumer products through high-quality third-party e-commerce channels while increasing awareness of rodent birth control as an effective approach to long-term rodent population management.
Evolve® products are expected to be available soon through Grove Collaborative's online marketplace at Grove.com.

Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard, from health to sustainability and performance, so you get great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, every order is carbon neutral and supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives. Shopping with purpose starts at Grove.com.

SenesTech is the leader in rodent birth control and sustainable rodent population management. The Company's Evolve® and ContraPest® fertility control solutions are designed to reduce rodent populations by targeting reproduction and can be used independently or as part of an integrated pest management (IPM) program. SenesTech serves consumer and professional markets with products, services and expertise that support effective, long-term rodent control. For more information, visit
